First run failed only because the sweep runner exported FANSERVICE_BROWSER_EXECUTABLE pointing at the Chromium binary and this script passes that env var as webkit.launch executablePath, so WebKit tried to launch Chromium ('Running as root without --no-sandbox'). Runner error, not a script/product failure. Correct re-run (env unset, xvfb-run) passed (rc=0): iPhone-shaped WebKit Edge controls, 12 edges, 510 bank, one winning settlement.

Original script with correct env: 1 pass / 5 runs. Fails at line 24 col 250: waitForFunction(()=>finished) times out after the portrait finish hold (mouse.down 1100ms, mouse.up). The finish hold is a 1000ms setTimeout (play.js beginFinishHold) cancelled on pointerup/move/pointercancel — 1100ms hold vs 1000ms timer leaves 100ms of margin, and WebKit-under-xvfb scheduling jitter eats it. The hold path itself works: instrumented copy passed (finished=true immediately after mouse.up), and an unmodified re-run passed once. Flaky, not a deterministic regression. Emulation only; not physical iOS Safari/device acceptance.
